findings.title: مجمع الشفاء الطبي في غزة يستعيد 60% من خدماته رغم دمار الاحتلال
findings.location: Al-Shifa Medical Complex, Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Hospital functioning capacity, emergency services, interventional radiology, renal dialysis, and patients requiring tertiary care
findings.exact_supporting_passage: المستشفى نجح في استعادة نحو 60% من قدراته التشغيلية السابقة
findings.source_type: Established Palestinian newspaper; reporting attributed to hospital director Mohammad Abu Salmiya and medical/official sources
findings.summary: Al-Quds reported on 15 November that Al-Shifa had recovered roughly 60% of its former operating capacity amid ongoing repairs. It describes an adapted emergency receiving area, revived interventional radiology, and dialysis services. Exact dates of the individual restarts are not established.

discovery_context.reason_qualifies: Newly traceable, specific operational-capacity update absent from prior watch findings; material healthcare functioning-capacity class.
discovery_context.limitations: Single outlet; 60% is a reported approximation not independently measured, and no new service launch during this hour is claimed.

findings.title: مصر تستقبل الدفعة 101 من الجرحى الفلسطينيين عبر معبر رفح وسط تحذيرات صحية دولية
findings.affected_population_system: Wounded and ill Palestinians transferred for medical care in Egyptian hospitals; Egyptian Red Crescent assistance
findings.exact_supporting_passage: الدفعة الأولى بعد المئة من الجرحى والمرضى الفلسطينيين القادمين من قطاع غزة
findings.source_type: Established Palestinian newspaper reporting attributed to Egyptian medical/relief teams and local sources
findings.summary: Al-Quds reported that Egyptian medical and relief teams received the 101st batch of wounded and ill Palestinians from Gaza via Rafah on Sunday 15 November. Patient headcount, names, and WHO verification were unavailable. '101st batch' is an ordinal, not 101 patients.

discovery_context.reason_qualifies: Newly surfaced specific reported medical transfer event not present in prior hourly heartbeat; material medical evacuation/transport class.
discovery_context.limitations: Single outlet; no verified headcount, no primary Egyptian Red Crescent/WHO independent readback; the transfer is reported as an arrival on 15 November, not as a verified crossing change.
